description: Run any operation from api_find by id (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE). Writes default to dry_run:true and return exactly what would be sent — show the user, then repeat with dry_run:false. Refuses writes to routes a dedicated tool owns (it names the tool) and irreversible account operations (page/domain deletion, org members/roles/transfers, permissions, billing, credentials). Required keys are checked against the call sheet before sending.

body.description: JSON body for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE (keys from the call sheet)

dry_run.description: Default true for writes: describe, don't send

method.description: With path, when id is not given

org_id.description: Organization sent as x-org-id ('personal' = none); default: the configured org. Many routes need it.

path_params.description: Values for :params in the path (page_id, org_id…); org_id defaults to the selected organization

pick.description: Keep only these fields on each item of a list result (or on a single object)

name: api_call
